scope: Union of all names in data/reference/augments.md, every variant in Catalog.augments, and active augment IDs of set 18 in the newest local CDragon source; case/punctuation variants stay separate exact names. The underlying MetaTFT snapshot is checked even before Markdown is built.
policy: Ratings describe controller mechanisms, never augment strength or comp fit. Poorly requires at least one missing required mechanism; supported automatic stats/economy/items are well. Missing source text alone is not evidence of a controller fault. Poorly is a lower-priority mark, never a ban; owner comp bans remain independent.

pandora_recheck.result: The cited failure predates e140; changed names now stay unknown until fresh tooltip confirmation, with recorded crop and multi-round regression coverage. No missing required control remains demonstrated by the cited record.

automatic_effect.requires: Game applies combat stats, economy, combat summons or rewards without a new controller action.

evidence.finding: Offered and held card texts are supplied to the model; the game applies their automatic effects.

automatic_effect.limitation: Well means no required unsupported control established; it does not grade augment strength or model strategy.

economy.requires: Observe gold, level, XP, free rerolls and interest.

evidence.finding: HUD gold/level/XP/free-roll counts are read; planner.econ_line accounts for held interest augments.

economy.limitation: The evaluator is not a full combat or economy simulator; ordinary automatic bonuses do not require one.

champion_delivery.requires: Identify champions granted now or later, including upgraded copies.

evidence.finding: Unbought arrivals are adopted, named through their panels and star badges, and delivered units can be placed by name.

item_delivery.requires: Read and equip components, completed items, Artifacts, Radiants and Emblems.

evidence.finding: Item-bench tooltips and held-item rows feed records and verified gives; items.py includes the e140 Radiant bank.

loot_pickup.requires: Collect ordinary loot orbs and observe the resulting items, champions or gold.

evidence.finding: Orbs are detected and collected; e123 scans again just after the augment; arrivals are read.

anvil_container.requires: Open recognized component, completed-item or Artifact anvils occupying bench slots.

evidence.finding: Shipped templates cover anvil_grey_small, artifact_anvil and item_anvil; Player.auto_open_container sells them to open their offer.

targeted_consumable.requires: Use ordinary removers, reforgers, duplicators, boosters or Lucky Item Chests on a unit.

evidence.finding: Game text identifies consumables; Player.give_item verifies use, records duplicator copies and handles remover/reforger returns.

later_item_trait_choice.requires: Choose now or later from a standard item/trait reward row.

evidence.finding: Choose One rows with 2-5 options are read and sent as named options; their card positions are clicked.

later_augment_choice.requires: Read a delayed augment replacement offered in a subsequent round.

evidence.finding: Augment choice identity uses the full stage-round string, not just its stage number; a later round resets the used-reroll set and reads a fresh hand. Coach.ask also resets its card memory for that round.

fixed_position_rows.requires: Place champions on known hexes, in specified rows, alone, adjacent or isolated in pairs.

evidence.finding: State gives every unit hex; board orders use row/column coordinates and swaps; alone-in-row conditions are also reported.

fixed_position_rows.limitation: No general opposing-board scouting or combat-stat simulator; fixed own-board geometry is available.

bench_position.requires: Put a champion in a particular bench slot, such as leftmost or rightmost.

evidence.finding: Bench slots 0-8 are exposed and can be targeted by a bench order, with occupied-slot swaps.

known_board_object.requires: Identify and move Training Dummies, Golems, BFFs or known plants as extra board bodies.

evidence.finding: Current source names include Golem and Training Dummy; ScreenReader.read_panel recognizes objects and they use zero team slots.

bench_item_randomization.requires: Follow items that the game randomizes or transforms on the item bench.

evidence.finding: Different icons dispute old names; e140 hides disputed names across rounds until tooltip correction; Player.identify_item prioritizes disputes and give_item verifies the slot.

bench_item_randomization.limitation: Game 52 lines 996-999, 1121-1122 and 1199-1208 exposed stale Radiant identities before 3f45be4; tests/test_game52_approved_requests.py now replays those crops and name changes. No remaining missing mechanism established by that record.

equipped_item_changes.requires: Observe items transformed, upgraded, copied or expiring on champions without a give.

evidence.finding: Repeated changed item-row reads replace records; a shortened row requests a confirming panel read; Radiant forms have their own names.

equipped_item_changes.limitation: This covers observation, not changed crafting recipes or automatic sale disassembly.

unit_transformation.requires: Reread named champions after an augment transforms them, once or every round.

evidence.finding: Transform text marks affected records for panel reads; rightmost bench slots are filtered correctly; recurring_changes reruns at round starts and identify_one updates name/star/items.

star_upgrade.requires: Observe a champion automatically upgraded on purchase, merge or reward.

evidence.finding: Repeated star badges and panel stars correct upgrades and reconcile consumed copies.

star_upgrade.limitation: Does not provide star/price information about a still-unbought shop card.

team_capacity.requires: Use a team-size increase or reduction, including a temporary one.

evidence.finding: HUD n/m supplies team capacity independently of level, including Solo Leveling; the same cap reaches plans and moves.

field_composition.requires: Field a number of champions of specified costs, stars, traits or duplicate identities.

evidence.finding: Names, star levels, costs, hexes, duplicate copies and trait counts are available to the model and board executor.
Sell orders verify identity and disappearance or gold gain, and update the roster and returned-item expectations.

roll_action.requires: Refresh the shop a chosen number of times or to specified targets.

evidence.finding: Plans support roll counts, gold floors, targets and free rerolls; shops and outcomes are reread.

level_action.requires: Buy XP or plan a target level.

evidence.finding: Level/XP state and XP orders are available; Player.note_xp_per_buy learns changed XP per purchase such as Level Up!.

craft_action.requires: Equip ordinary components and make their normal completed recipe.

evidence.finding: The planner and verified give executor use component recipes and equipped item capacity.

quest_timed_rewards.requires: Keep playing while game counts wins, combat damage, rounds, upgrades or other automatic quest progress.

evidence.finding: Round, streak, HP, board and held card effects are in state; gold, champion and item payouts are observed as arrivals.

quest_timed_rewards.limitation: Arbitrary live augment counters, stored payouts and target identities are not read. Automatic progress/payout alone is not rated poorly; quests needing an unread target use a separate missing mechanism.

carousel_reward.requires: Choose carousel components and identify rewards, or receive an automatic unpicked reward.

evidence.finding: Carousel selection is supported and arriving champion/items are checked independently of the requested pick.

wisp_purchase.requires: Purchase Wisps and observe their champion, item or economy effects.

evidence.finding: Wisp offers are read and offered as plan decisions; bought Wisps and their effects are reported, including this-round purchase counts.

combat_only_transformation.requires: Let the game temporarily upgrade or clone units during combat without changing their permanent owned identity.

evidence.finding: Identity rereads of fighting board units are excluded; ordinary planning reads restore the permanent board, while the game performs combat upgrades and summons.

combat_only_transformation.limitation: Combat clones are not separately actionable owned champions; their exact combat stats are not simulated.

trait_choice.requires: Choose supported trait/Primal/Coven options and use an Alpha Mark.

evidence.finding: Trait/Primal/Coven card names are recognized; Kha'Zix evolution is recorded and Alpha Mark is reusable.

altered_crafting.requires: Honor recipes/equip rules changed by the augment.

evidence.finding: Recipe and capacity predictions stay ordinary; no held-augment override is passed to these functions or give_item.

altered_crafting.failure: The item planner and give verifier use ordinary recipes and equip rules, so the changed crafting result is predicted or verified as an ordinary completed item.

reforge_to_container.requires: Verify reforging that creates an anvil instead of returned item-bench items.

evidence.finding: The Reforger path waits for item-bench count to increase by the number of stripped items; it does not accept a champion-bench anvil as the result.

reforge_to_container.failure: The Reforger verifier requires items to return to the item bench, so a successful conversion into a bench anvil is reported as a failed use.

sale_disassembly.requires: Record components returned when selling a champion breaks its completed items.

evidence.finding: Sales expect a.arg.items unchanged; an unknown return can inherit the old completed-item name instead of its recipe components.

sale_disassembly.failure: The sale tracker expects the old completed items back instead of their components, so returned component slots can retain incorrect completed-item identities.

consumable_unit_transform.requires: Invalidate the target identity after a unit-transforming consumable.

evidence.finding: A used consumable returns success after duplicate bookkeeping without queuing a target identity reread; unit_change is called for augment/Wisp purchases, not this use.

consumable_unit_transform.failure: Using a transforming consumable does not queue a new unit-panel read, so the target keeps its previous champion identity in the roster.
consumable_unit_transform.limitation: Appearance checks may later notice the new model; a successful consumable use itself does not invalidate its target identity.

unknown_special_unit.requires: Identify a special champion outside the catalog and known board-object names.

evidence.finding: Panel names match catalog champions or state.board_objects; neither Changeling nor the unnamed Isekai hero has an entry.

unknown_special_unit.failure: The special unit has no recognized champion or board-object identity, so its panel cannot establish a named unit for planning and verified actions.

mass_roster_replacement.requires: Retire replaced board and bench records when the augment deletes or sells the roster.

evidence.finding: Only transform wording triggers rereads; deletion/replacement has no event handler and a still-occupied bench slot retains its prior identity.

mass_roster_replacement.failure: The augment replaces the roster without a transform event, so occupied replacement slots can keep records of the removed champions.
mass_roster_replacement.limitation: Appearance checks and board surveys may recover replacement identities later; they do not provide a roster-replacement transaction or retire all deleted bench records at the augment.

bench_unit_consumption.requires: Retire champions consumed from a bench slot each round.

evidence.finding: An emptied named bench unit is kept as missing; a new occupant can inherit that missing identity; no Expedition consumption event exists.

bench_unit_consumption.failure: Consumed bench champions are retained as missing records instead of being retired, so later arrivals can inherit identities of champions already consumed.

random_hex_perception.requires: Read randomly placed empowered hexes and provide their coordinates.

evidence.finding: Extras read lobby, streak, odds, gifts, items and bench objects, but no random augment-hex detector or coordinates.

random_hex_perception.failure: The empowered hex locations are not read into state, so the model cannot place units on the actual bonus hexes.

spotlight_footprint.requires: Read the area of an augment spotlight.

evidence.finding: No spotlight detector supplies the affected hexes; back corner alone does not establish its footprint.

spotlight_footprint.failure: The spotlight footprint is not read into state, so the model cannot determine which board hexes receive its bonuses.

bench_trait_contribution.requires: Count traits supplied by a benched champion.

evidence.finding: tracked_traits counts roster.board only; no held-augment path contributes rightmost-bench traits.

bench_trait_contribution.failure: Trait reconciliation ignores the benched trait contributor, so real extra trait counts are treated as a board mismatch.

special_trait_grant.requires: Record an augment-granted chosen trait and extra trait count on Lux.

evidence.finding: Chosen-trait bookkeeping handles game-data evolutions (Kha'Zix), not an augment-granted Lux trait or its +2 count.

special_trait_grant.failure: The chosen Lux trait and its extra count are not recorded, so the trait model undercounts the board and can trigger false reconciliation.

extra_item_team_slots.requires: Account for an item making its holder consume an additional team slot.

evidence.finding: Slots depend only on champion rules and slotless objects; held Mogul's Mail adds no slot.

extra_item_team_slots.failure: Team-slot accounting ignores the extra slot used by the item holder, so a lineup can be treated as legal when the game refuses it.

reduced_bench.requires: Use a bench with fewer than nine legal slots.

evidence.finding: free_bench always enumerates range(9); planner bench validation also allows 0-8, with no augment capacity.

reduced_bench.failure: The roster and bench executor assume nine usable slots, so purchases and bench moves can target slots disabled by the augment.

changed_shop_prices.requires: Read changing champion shop prices rather than catalog base costs.

evidence.finding: Shop reads gold and five names, not card prices; purchase budgets and sell values use catalog base cost.

changed_shop_prices.failure: Shop budgets use fixed catalog costs rather than the shuffled prices, so affordability and sale-value calculations are wrong.

changed_roll_price.requires: Budget paid shop refreshes at a price other than two gold.

evidence.finding: Paid-refresh affordability, reserves and local gold subtraction all use two gold, with no reroll-price observation.

changed_roll_price.failure: Paid-refresh budgets always charge two gold, so the cheaper rerolls are misbudgeted and can stop before the requested count.

changed_xp_price.requires: Budget and verify XP purchases at a price other than four gold.

evidence.finding: Budgets use gold // 4 and landed buys use round(gold_delta / 4); note_xp_per_buy learns XP gained per buy but not its gold price.

changed_xp_price.failure: XP purchase budgets and confirmation always use four gold per buy, so discounted purchases can be undercounted and their XP yield learned incorrectly.

opponent_history.requires: Observe which other players have fielded a given champion over the game.

evidence.finding: The lobby reader observes names/HP/eliminations, not opponent roster histories; no historical fielded-champion table reaches the prompt.

opponent_history.failure: Opponent champion histories are not read, so the model cannot identify which bench champion satisfies the payout condition for other players.

shop_card_stars.requires: Read upgraded shop cards before purchase and account for their stars and price.

evidence.finding: Shop cards expose names only; bought initially records a one-star copy and may merge before a later badge correction.

shop_card_stars.failure: Shop cards have no star or price field, so upgraded purchases are initially budgeted and merged as ordinary one-star copies.

extra_augment_rerolls.requires: Track more than one reroll per augment card.

evidence.finding: rerolled is a set of indices, each allowed only once; there is no remaining-reroll count per card.

extra_augment_rerolls.failure: Augment rerolls are tracked as a once-per-card set, so the additional rerolls are never offered to the model.

random_held_augment.requires: Discover which augment a random augment-granting card actually awarded.

evidence.finding: augments_taken appends only the clicked card name; no held-augment panel reader discovers the randomly granted card.

random_held_augment.failure: Only the selected grant card is recorded, so the identity and requirements of the randomly awarded augment are absent from state.

champion_choice_row.requires: Read champion names in a special shop or grow/keep choices.

evidence.finding: Choice matching accepts item and trait/Primal/Coven names, not champion names or Grow Up/Keep options; raw unmatched card text is not sent.

champion_choice_row.failure: The choice reader has no champion or grow/keep option vocabulary, so the model receives unnamed options instead of the offered champion choices.

special_portal_container.requires: Recognize and sell a Treasure Portal to release stored loot.

evidence.finding: Container templates cover only three anvil classes; unknown objects are blocked and cannot be opened by open_container.

special_portal_container.failure: The Treasure Portal has no recognized unit or container template, so its stored loot cannot be released through the container executor.

reusable_gold_tool.requires: Use a reusable gold-spending Training Manual and observe its changing price.

evidence.finding: Only Alpha Mark is reusable; Training Manual has no reusable-use verifier or live cost field, so a use that leaves it on the bench is not confirmed.

reusable_gold_tool.failure: The reusable tool verifier recognizes only Alpha Mark and does not read the Training Manual cost, so paid uses that leave the tool on the bench cannot be confirmed correctly.

round_item_plan_revalidation.requires: Revalidate item plans made a round earlier after the bench items change every round.

evidence.finding: A next_round plan runs from the previous round; changed bench items require fresh tooltip reads. Game 52 (20261101-205238), 3-5 to 4-3: earlier planned items changed before delivery. e140 now re-reads changed names, but that does not preserve the earlier item plan.

patch_recheck.conclusion: No changed card introduces a new required controller mechanism. Retained all mechanism ratings, including existing poorly ratings; numeric strength and game-side bug fixes do not change capability ratings. Offered cards and actual HUD/rewards remain observed rather than simulated.
patch_recheck.availability: No new active augment IDs. DA_HeartOfSteel was removed from the active set list since the October 21 snapshot, consistent with its already documented 18.5 disable. It stays rated because generic catalog/MetaTFT variants still exist; Solo Leveling disable is Choncc or Treat-specific.
patch_recheck.followup_conclusion: Reassessed all 39 currently recorded changed-source cards (a superset of the 38 in the brief). II+ and II++ require the same missing round_item_plan_revalidation as Pandora's Items II and are now poorly. Every other rating, mechanism and reason is preserved.
